header.name: Adjust Inventory in Fuuz
header.description:
This flow is our main handle for updating inventory in Fuuz.  

If quality codes are provided we need to make sure to add/delete them as needed. This flow will also track what changed on the inventory in the Before/After scenario to ensure we can capture an inventory transaction showing the state of the inventory before the change and after the change.

Called from:

1. Inventory Adjustment screen to manage inventory updates.

version.description:
Adjusting any nodes mutating "Inventory Transaction"

Adjust CustomData to handle cases where a user triggered a parent flow that called this flow using ExecuteFlow.

CustomData checks if CLAIMS was passed in at the request node, if not then it uses the claims passed from the users request.
